tools.name: find_representatives
tools.description: Resolve a U.S. street address or ZIP code to its two senators and House member, sitting members only. An address resolves to one exact district. A ZIP code that spans districts returns each district holding 1% or more of its land (location.districts) and the member for each; a district holding less

tools.name: search_members
tools.description: Find members of Congress by name, or list them by state, chamber or party. Use this first to turn a name such as "Chuck Schumer" or "AOC" into the Bioguide ID the other tools need. Nicknames, close spellings, titles ("Rep.", "Sen.") and a seat hint such as "(R-TX)" are understood. A name search also

tools.name: get_member
tools.description: A member of Congress by Bioguide ID: seat, party, whether they are serving now, terms, vote statistics, and their ten latest votes.

tools.name: get_member_record
tools.description: A member's record in 60 seconds: seat, serving since, roll calls and votes cast / not voting this Congress, and the ten most recent votes with position and a link to each roll call. Use for a quick, neutral summary of how a member votes. Cite the record canonical URL and each vote's source_url.

tools.name: get_member_votes
tools.description: Recorded votes for a member, newest first, with the question, bill, position, and official source. Pass bill to answer "how did this member vote on H.R. 1" (every roll call on that bill), position to list only their Nay or Not Voting votes, and since / until for a date range. Page with offset.

tools.name: get_member_bills
tools.description: Bills a member sponsored (the newest 20) and cosponsored (the newest 10), with totals. The lists can be incomplete; each result links the member's full list on Congress.gov.

tools.name: compare_members
tools.description: How often two members of the same chamber voted the same way this Congress: the roll calls both voted Yea or Nay on, how many matched, and their ten most recent differing votes. A plain count over the whole record, not a score.

tools.name: get_recent_votes
tools.description: Roll-call votes, newest first, with the question, bill, tally and derived result. tools.name: get_roll_call
tools.description: One roll-call vote: the question, bill, tally, party split, derived result, and how members voted. tools.name: search_bills
tools.description: Search bills by words in the title (every word must appear) or by bill number (e.g. "H.R. 1", "119-s-5051"), most recently introduced first. Narrow with congress, stage (e.g. enacted), sponsor (a Bioguide ID) or has_vote for bills that reached a recorded floor vote.

tools.name: get_bill
tools.description: A bill with sponsor, stage, official CRS summary, and every recorded floor vote.

tools.name: explain_bill
tools.description: A plain-English explanation of a bill for readers with no background in government: a one-sentence summary, short paragraphs and key points, written by AI from the bill's official text (or the CRS summary when the text is not published). findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_recent_votes" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
